secrets.name: JWT_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Signs TriVault session JWTs. A development placeholder is committed in .env.base44-defaults (>=32 chars) so the app boots with no credentials; replace it with your own generated value (python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))", or openssl rand -hex 32) before any real deployment.

secrets.name: FERNET_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Fernet key (32 url-safe base64 bytes) used to encrypt uploaded files. A development placeholder is committed in .env.base44-defaults; replace it with your own Fernet.generate_key() before any real deployment. Changing it makes previously stored shards undecryptable.
